title: agent-surface Snapshot
description: Output of `agent-surface snapshot [path] --json` (plan 3.4 / 3.7, JG-152). Byte-deterministic: object keys are sorted, entries are sorted by key, file, json_pointer. Absent information is always null, never 0, an empty string or an empty object.

schema_version.description: Schema version of this document. A reader that supports another version must refuse the file (exit 3).

semantics_doc_date.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the Claude Code documentation the interpretations derive from.

min_claude_version.description: Lowest Claude Code version the semantics are known to hold for; null when not asserted (V0).

assumptions.description: Assumptions header (plan 3.7): a fixed ordered list of strings, followed by discovery and extraction notes (tracked local file, non-empty enabledPlugins).

sources.description: One record per supported file, sorted by path.

entries.description: Control-surface entries sorted by key, then file, then json_pointer.

incomplete.description: Reasons the scan cannot be rendered as clean. Non-empty means exit 3 wherever this snapshot is used.

spec.description: The argument as given on the command line.

sha.description: Resolved commit SHA for git origins (carried through for snapshot origins); null otherwise.
Commit SHA the file was read at, or the literal "worktree" / "snapshot".

blob.description: Git blob object id when read from a ref; null otherwise.

tracked.description: Whether git tracks the file; null when not determinable.

note.description: Human-readable flag, e.g. the tracked settings.local.json notice.

lines.description: 1-based line numbers involved, or null when the reason is not tied to a line.

key.description: Stable identity: perm:<allow|ask|deny>:<canonical rule>, mode:<key>, hook:<event>:<matcher>:<sha256>, mcp:<server>, dir:<path>, sandbox:<key>, env_key:<NAME>, helper:<key>, plugin_flag:<key>, unknown:<json_pointer>, credential:<json_pointer>.

value.description: Normalized value. Shape depends on kind (see src/entries.ts). Never carries an env value or a credential-like literal; those are replaced by "<redacted>".

breadth.description: Breadth of a perm rule; null for every other kind. Set by the interpretations (CS-C); "unknown" until then.

file.description: Repository-relative path the entry came from.

line.description: 1-based line of the value in the source file, or null if unknown.

json_pointer.description: RFC 6901 pointer of the value, or null if unknown.

source_sha.description: Commit SHA the file was read at, or null for worktree reads.
